verdict.rationale: The only design-tool evidence is the Figma integration, which embeds Figma prototypes inside ClickUp Tasks, Docs, and Chat. That is the reverse direction: it brings designs into ClickUp rather than letting a designer update ClickUp status from within the design tool. The Public API and MCP server are developer building blocks rather than a shipped design-tool plugin, so they earn no credit, and nothing in the pack shows status updates from inside Figma or any other design app.
